_doc: Manual corrections applied on top of the automatic fit (tools/fit_poses.py). Keys are pose ids (sNN = sprite NN). 'angles' / 'root' entries replace the fitted values; 'channels' set non-skeletal parameters that a silhouette cannot show: headYaw in degrees (0 = facing the audience, negative = turned towards screen left, +-180 = back view), headPitch 0..1 (looking down / nodding). Every override below is a hypothesis read by eye from the sprite and the recording, not a measurement.

s23._why: eyes shifted to screen left: starting the turn

s26._why: back view; automatic fit folded both arms into the torso

s27._why: eyes shifted to screen right: finishing the turn

s28._why: curtain call: hands on hips, head dipped ~2 px in the recording

s29._why: curtain call bow: head drops ~5 px, right arm sweeps down and out, left hand on hip. A forward bow cannot be shown by in-plane rotation of rigid parts, so it is rendered as a head nod plus a small plie.

s30._why: curtain call: hands on hips with a cocky head tilt
